Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie

Class GameConfig

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.GameConfig
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameConfig extends Object implements Serializable
Represents all the general settings of the game:
  • number of players
  • bookshelf dimension
  • number of common goals
  • number of tiles per type
  • living room size
  • number of personal goals
  • personal goal ratio

      public GameConfig(int numPlayers, Dimension bookshelfDimension, int numCommonGoal, int numTilesPerType, int livingRoomSize, int numPersonalGoals, double personalGoalRatio) throws InvalidParameterException
      Costum constructor.
      Parameters:
      numPlayers - the number of players in the game.
      bookshelfDimension - the dimension of the bookshelf.
      numCommonGoal - the number of common goals per player.
      numTilesPerType - the number of tiles per type.
      livingRoomSize - the dimension of the living room
      numPersonalGoals - the number of personal goals per player.
      personalGoalRatio - the filling percentage of the personal goal.
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if the number of players or personal gaols is not valid, or the size of the bookshelf and the living room is not valid.
